author: Raina Ceaough
title: ISO Artist to Contract for $100 USD - Pokemon/Chibi Art
content:
FOUND THANK YOU
Do not DM/send friend request without permission = BLOCKED

ISO Artist to Contract for $100 USD - MOP: PayPal

Hi there I'm looking for a personal artist! Someone who can draw a lot for me and is okay with me using their art for commercial purposes (Ex. Sticker designs, advertising, etc). 

Duration: 1 month

Offer: $100 USD

MOP: PAYPAL

Terms: A minimum of 20 art pieces 

Ranging from doodles/lineart - full body flat color/cell shading. I will NOT be requesting 20 full illustrations, looking for someone who can do small projects/artworks quickly with a cute chibi/anime art style. Looking for things like Pokemon and animals to be drawn primarily but also humans/furry characters

I am a digital artist myself and have premade sketches/designs that I want turned into clean lineart or flat colored finished drawings. NOT to be traced/copied but take inspiration from and use your own style.

If this is something you are okay with please post your examples below and your portfolio if you have one.

Pics of art styles im seeking below

Contact method: Post your examples and portfolio in the comments (Do not DM/send friend request without permission).

title: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator (Anime Style)
content:
